reports.title: Departamento de Santa Cruz — low-poverty economic hub
reports.description: Eastern lowland department and the country’s main agro-industrial and commercial engine. Lowest departmental poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Economic counterweight to the highland departments. Poverty incidence among the lowest in the country (~20–25% range in recent readings); hosts the bulk of soy, beef and related agro-industry.

reports.title: Departamento de Potosí — high-poverty highland contrast
reports.description: Highland mining department with among the highest poverty and extreme-poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Poverty-contrast department. Frequently ranks near the top of departmental poverty (mid-to-high 40s–50s % in recent years) despite its historic and ongoing mining role.

reports.title: Departamento de Chuquisaca — high-poverty contrast
reports.description: Southern highland/valley department with elevated poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Completes the high-poverty highland set alongside Potosí. Poverty incidence often above 50% in recent readings.

reports.title: Departamento de La Paz — capital region
reports.description: Western highland department containing the seat of government (La Paz) and El Alto. Intermediate-to-higher poverty and the largest absolute number of people in poverty.
reports._notes: Demographic and political core. Large absolute poverty mass even when rates are not the highest; hosts the dual-city complex of La Paz and El Alto.

reports.title: La Paz / El Alto — dual-city metropolitan complex
reports.description: Dual-city capital complex: La Paz (seat of government) and the adjacent, rapidly grown city of El Alto on the Altiplano. Primary urban domain for labour, income, poverty and social-programme analysis in the western highlands.
reports._notes: Lived-economy core of the western highlands. El Alto in particular is a dense, commercially dynamic, largely Aymara city that grew from migration; multidimensional poverty readings remain elevated. Continuously cited as a distinct geographic domain in household-survey and urban-poverty analysis.

reports.title: Yacimientos de Litio Bolivianos (YLB) — state lithium company
reports.publisher: YLB / Ministerio de Hidrocarburos y Energía
reports.description: State company charged with the industrialisation of Bolivia’s lithium resources, centred on the Salar de Uyuni (world’s largest known resources). Contracts with Chinese and Russian partners for direct-extraction plants.
reports._notes: Strategic future-resource node. Production remains far below commercial scale relative to Chile and Argentina; recent contracts (CBC/China, Uranium One/Russia) aim to scale direct lithium extraction. Continuously cited in industrial-policy and fiscal-revenue outlook analysis.

reports.title: Salar de Uyuni — lithium resource base
reports.description: World’s largest known lithium resource (salt flat in Potosí department). Geographic and symbolic core of Bolivia’s lithium strategy.
reports._notes: Foundational natural-resource node. Continuously cited as the physical base of the lithium industrialisation effort; also a national and Indigenous heritage symbol.

reports.title: Departamento de Cochabamba — central valley hub
reports.description: Central valley department and the third major population and economic pole after La Paz and Santa Cruz. Intermediate poverty and large absolute poverty mass.
reports._notes: Completes the central economic axis (La Paz–Cochabamba–Santa Cruz). Large absolute number of people in poverty even when rates are not the highest.

reports.title: Departamento de Tarija — southern gas and agricultural zone
reports.description: Southern department historically linked to gas production and agricultural activity. Intermediate poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Gas-producing department. Poverty rates intermediate; economic structure has been shaped by the hydrocarbon cycle that is now contracting.

reports.title: Departamento de Oruro — highland mining
reports.description: Highland mining department with intermediate-to-elevated poverty.
reports._notes: Mining geography. Completes the highland departmental set alongside Potosí, Chuquisaca and La Paz.

reports.title: Departamento del Beni — northern lowland
reports.description: Northern Amazonian lowland department. Intermediate poverty with marked urban–rural gaps.
reports._notes: Lowland contrast to the highland departments. Completes the geographic coverage of the main departmental poverty gradient.

reports.title: Empresas públicas — performance and fiscal exposure
reports.description: State-owned enterprise sector (YPFB, YLB, BoA, Mi Teleférico, Mutún, etc.). Material source of fiscal risk when losses and debt accumulate.
reports._notes: Lived fiscal-risk node. A large group of state firms have operated at a loss; a subset has been flagged as critically indebted. Restructuring and possible liquidation have entered the policy agenda as gas rents decline.

reports.title: Departamento de Pando — northern Amazonian extreme
reports.description: Northernmost Amazonian department. Low population density, intermediate poverty, and distinct lowland living conditions.
reports._notes: Completes the full departmental set. Geographic and demographic extreme relative to the highland and central-axis departments.

reports.title: Eje central (La Paz – Cochabamba – Santa Cruz)
reports.description: The three-department demographic and economic corridor that concentrates the majority of population, formal activity, remittance inflows and absolute poverty numbers.
reports._notes: Analytical geography node. Most remittances, formal jobs and absolute poverty counts sit on this axis; the rest of the country is thinner demographically and economically.

reports.title: Territorios Indígena Originario Campesinos (TIOC)
reports.description: Indigenous Originary Peasant Territories — recognised collective territorial units that appear as geographic domains in census and survey tabulations.
reports._notes: Plurinational territorial node. Continuously cited as a distinct geographic and rights unit in official statistics and policy.
_referenced_by: Poverty and service-access studies that disaggregate by TIOC

reports.title: Contrato litio YLB–CBC (China)
reports.description: Investment and service contract for direct lithium extraction and residual-brine plants in the Salar de Uyuni area, with Chinese consortium participation and majority state stake.
reports._notes: Major international industrial-investment instrument. Part of the attempt to scale lithium production from the current low base; subject to ongoing political and legislative scrutiny.
_referenced_by: Policy debate on contract transparency and local benefit

reports.title: Contrato litio YLB–Uranium One (Rusia)
reports.description: Investment contract for a direct lithium extraction plant with Russian partner, complementary to the Chinese CBC arrangement.
reports._notes: Second major international lithium-investment instrument. Together with the CBC contract, defines the current external partnership architecture for lithium industrialisation.

reports.title: Relación energética Bolivia–Brasil (gasoducto y gas)
reports.description: Long-standing natural-gas export relationship with Brazil via the Bolivia–Brazil gas pipeline. Still the principal residual gas-export market after the end of the Argentina contract.
reports._notes: Core bilateral energy relationship. Volumes have declined but Brazil remains the main residual buyer; recent high-level statements explore ways to stabilise or expand cooperation.
_referenced_by: Analysis of the structural decline in gas volumes

reports.title: Relación comercial con China
reports.description: Bilateral trade relationship with China — major destination for minerals and origin of imports, and partner in lithium industrialisation.
reports._notes: Structural commercial and investment partner. Continuously cited in export (minerals) and import (machinery, intermediates) analysis and in the lithium partnership architecture.

dependencies.basis: Ministerio de Educacion, Resolucion Ministerial 0613/2025 (reglamento de entrega del Bono Juancito Pinto 2025), Art. 6: beneficiary students are those «registrados en la Base de Datos del Sistema de Informacion Educativa (SIE) del Ministerio de Educacion, registrados como efectivos y con calificaciones hasta el segundo trimestre de la gestion 2025»; Art. 3 requires them to be «matriculados y registrados en el Sistema de Informacion Educativa (SIE) con estado de matricula EFECTIVOS».

dependencies.basis: Decreto Supremo 0066 (Bono Madre Nino-Nina Juana Azurduy), Art. 3: the corresponsabilidad schedule is 4 controles prenatales, parto institucional mas control post-natal and 12 controles bimestrales integrales de salud, and «En todos los casos, los pagos seran entregados despues de verificado el cumplimiento de los controles.» Art. 6: «Las redes y equipos moviles de salud, tienen la responsabilidad de prestar los servicios de atencion integral de salud, realizar la verificacion del cumplimiento de los controles», with «Los Servicios Departamentales de Salud apoyaran con los servicios de salud que se requieran».
